title: Balance of payments
summary: All economic transactions between residents of the UK and the rest of the world.

title: Earnings and working hours
summary: Average weekly earnings of people in the UK and information on the gender pay gap and low pay. Data from Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) and the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE).

title: Economic inactivity
summary: People not in employment who have not been seeking work within the last 4 weeks and/or are unable to start work within the next 2 weeks.

title: Employment and employee types
summary: Employment rates show the number of people in paid work as a proportion of the population, broken down by age and sex. Includes information on the number of people in employment and vacancies.

title: Gross disposable household income
summary: Gross disposable household income is the amount of money that individuals in the household sector can spend or save after income distribution measures. Figures cover regions, sub-regions and local areas of the UK.

title: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
summary: Gross domestic product (GDP) estimates are the main measure of UK economic growth based on the value of goods and services produced during a given period. GDP estimates are produced monthly, quarterly and annually as part of the revisions cycle to ensure the timely release of data throughout the year. Our GDP monthly estimate consists of output data and is our most timely official estimate of economic growth. The two publication stages for quarterly estimates are our GDP first quarterly estimate and our quarterly national accounts, which include data on output, expenditure and income.

title: Gross Value Added (GVA)
summary: Estimates of regional gross value added (GVA), which is the value generated by any unit engaged in the production of goods and services. Figures available for local authorities and NUTS regions.

title: Inflation and price indices
summary: The rate of inflation is the change in prices for goods and services over time. Measures of inflation and prices include consumer price inflation, producer price inflation and the House Price Index.

title: International trade
summary: Trade in goods and services across the UK's international borders, including total imports and exports, the types of goods and services traded and general trends in international trade.

title: Investments, pensions and trusts
summary: Net flows of investment into the UK, the number of people who hold pensions of different types, and investments made by various types of trusts.

title: Labour productivity
summary: Efficiency of the UK workforce, including output per worker, per job and per hour. Data are available by industry and by region.

title: Manufacturing and production industry
summary: UK manufacturing and other production industries (such as mining and quarrying, energy supply, water supply and waste management), including total UK production output, and UK manufactures' sales by product and industrial division, with EU comparisons.

title: Mergers and acquisitions
summary: Business mergers and acquisitions involving UK companies, including de-mergers and disposals, where the transaction value is £1 million or more.

title: Out of work benefits
summary: Claimants of unemployment related benefits including Employment and Support Allowance and other incapacity benefits, and Income Support and Pension Credit.

title: Output
summary: Economic output and activity of the UK. Includes manufacturing, production and services, and other measures of economic activity.

title: Pensions, savings and investments
summary: State, private, occupational and workplace pensions, including pension trends that draws together data from other government departments and organisations.

title: Population estimates
summary: Annual population estimates. Figures are available for various administrative and electoral geographies and for different population sub-groups, for example, estimates of the very old and estimates by marital status.

title: Public sector finance
summary: How the relationship between UK public sector monthly income and expenditure leads to changes in deficit and debt.

title: Public sector personnel
summary: People employed in central and local government, and public corporations, including second jobs in the public sector. Includes Civil Service employment with regional and diversity analyses.

title: Redundancies
summary: People who have been made redundant or have taken voluntary redundancy.

title: Retail industry
summary: Sales by retailers in Great Britain directly to end consumers, including spending on goods (in store and online) (Retail Sales Index) and spending on services (Index of Services). The industry as a whole is used as an indicator of how the wider economy is performing and the strength of consumer spending.

title: Tourism industry
summary: Tourism and travel (including accommodation services, food and beverage services, passenger transport services, vehicle hire, travel agencies and sports, recreational and conference services), employment levels and output of the tourism industry, the number of visitors to the UK and the amount they spend.

title: UK sector accounts
summary: Transactions of particular groups of institutions within the UK economy, showing how the income from production is distributed and how savings are used to add wealth through investment in assets.

title: Unemployment
summary: UK unemployment figures. Information on the labour market, young people and workless households.

title: Workplace disputes and working conditions
summary: Work stoppages because of disputes between employers and employees. Includes strikes and lock-outs, number of days lost in the public and private sectors, and number of workers involved.
